title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 050 ]

blocks.text: A society lacking language would be incapable of engaging in any but the simplest of cooperative enterprises. An individual or group of individuals would have no way of planning such activities , of explaining them to others, or of directing the actions of the participants in cooperative enterprises toward the common goal. Each individual would be to a large extent dependent on his own strength and ability since he would lack the means of securing the help of others.

readingSentences.english: A society lacking language would be incapable of engaging in any but the simplest of cooperative enterprises.
readingSentences.korean: 언어가 결핍된 사회는 가장 단순한 협업이외의 어떤 일에 종사하는 것이 불가능할 것이다.

readingSentences.english: An individual or group of individuals would have no way of planning such activities , of explaining them to others, or of directing the actions of the participants in cooperative enterprises toward the common goal.
readingSentences.korean: 개인이나 개인의 집단은 그런 활동을 계획하거나 다른 이에게 그런 활동을 설명하거나 또는 공통의 목표를 향해 협업에 참가자들의 행위를 지도하는 어떤 방법을 가지지 않을 것이다.

readingSentences.english: Each individual would be to a large extent dependent on his own strength and ability since he would lack the means of securing the help of others.
readingSentences.korean: 왜냐하면 각 개인은 다른 사람의 도움을 확보하는 방법이 없을 것이기 때문에 상당한 정도까지 자신의 힘과 능력에 의존적일 것이다.
